summary: M3+M4 alerts implementation meets all requirements. AlertBanner is always mounted in the root layout (additive, minimal diff), full-width sticky bar with bg-[#E53E3E] text-white constant in both themes, animate-pulse warning icon, signal level 1-5 + typhoon name + joined affected areas + Filipino-formatted timestamp, dismissible via localStorage (klimaguard:alertDismissedSignal) with correct reappear-on-worsening (hides only while signalLevel <= dismissedSignal), and a tel:911 button at min-h/min-w 44px; mobile layout stacks (flex-col -> sm:row) so it is legible at 375px. EvacuationCard shows name/Layo/Kapasidad and a >=44px Direksyon link with Filipino labels. /alerts has skeleton loading (not a spinner), Filipino error + 'Subukang muli' retry wired to refetch, Filipino empty state, EvacuationCard grid, and an always-first hotlines section (G07) with 911 / Red Cross 143 / NDRRMC tel: links at >=44px. /api/alerts route has export const revalidate = 900, typed IAlertState mock, try/catch returning a status-200 Filipino-safe fallback (never 500). useAlerts is offline-first with localStorage caching and a 15-min staleness convention. Types are I-prefixed and exported in-file, no any, no console.log, one component per file, @/ imports, shared-file edits additive, globals.css and AGENTS.md untouched. npm run lint and npm run build both pass in the worktree (build route table confirms /api/alerts at 15m revalidate, /alerts prerendered static). Note: the branch was cut from the cycle-0 scaffold and does not contain main's later cycles (2/4/5), so a diff against current main shows unrelated deletions; the task's actual changes (vs merge-base) are correct and additive, but the integrator should merge/rebase onto current main rather than fast-forward.
